field_contract.fixture_family: One of the eight family identifiers in manifest.json.
field_contract.page_index: Zero-based page index within the generated fixture artifact.
field_contract.expected_route: Expected routing policy label for the page: deterministic_only, paddle_ocr, gemini_vlm, or hybrid.
field_contract.reading_order: Ordered block identifiers and expected text sequence for reading-order scoring.
field_contract.table_structure: Expected table captions, header hierarchy, row groups, merged cells, and unit rows. Use null when absent.
field_contract.key_fields: Named values or tokens that must be recovered for the page to pass.
field_contract.image_description_expectation: Expected chart, figure, or diagram description. Use null when no semantic image description is expected.
field_contract.bbox_tolerance: Per-block tolerance for bounding-box preservation, expressed as relative page-coordinate deltas.
field_contract.provider_allowances: Provider-specific acceptable differences for PaddleOCR official API and Gemini direct outputs.
field_contract.scoring_metrics: Metric names mapped to thresholds or qualitative pass criteria.
